Role permissions

Non-interactive reference. Switch "Signed in as" on the directory screen to see these outcomes live.

ActionHRManagerEmployeeSatisfies
Deactivate an active employeeAllowedAllowedRejected — status unchangedAC1, AC3, AC4
Reactivate a deactivated employeeAllowedAllowedRejected — status unchangedAC2, AC3, AC4
View a deactivated employee's recordFull details shownFull details shownFull details shownAC6

A rejected request never opens the confirm dialog and never changes the employee's status — the rejection happens at the point the action is attempted, same as the underlying API returning a 403. Viewing a record is never role-gated — only changing its status is.

Acceptance criteria checklist

Every acceptance criterion for this story, mapped to where it's demonstrated.

1

Deactivating an active employee sets status to deactivated — AC1

As HR or Manager, "Deactivate" on Priya Nair's row (or her profile) confirms and flips her status chip to "Deactivated" immediately.

2

Reactivating a deactivated employee sets status to active — AC2

As HR or Manager, "Reactivate" on Marcus Chen's row (or his profile) confirms and flips his status chip to "Active" immediately.

3

A status change is rejected without HR/Manager role — AC3

Switch "Signed in as" to Employee and click "Deactivate" or "Reactivate" anywhere: a "Request rejected" toast appears and the confirm dialog never opens — see "Role permissions".

4

Status remains unchanged after a rejected attempt — AC4

After the rejection in AC3, the employee's status chip is unchanged on both the directory row and the profile page — no write occurs.

5

No process other than a manual HR/Manager change alters status — AC5

Each profile's "Status history" shows exactly one automatic entry (set by onboarding completion) and otherwise only manual HR/Manager entries — there is no other source of a status change anywhere in this prototype.

6

A deactivated employee's record stays fully viewable — AC6

Open Marcus Chen's profile (currently deactivated, deep-linkable at #profile/emp_c003) in any role: every detail field and the full status history still render.

7

A just-changed status displays immediately on the profile page — AC7

Change status from the profile page itself (not just the directory row): the status chip at the top of the page updates the instant the confirm dialog closes, with no reload.
